People: William Shakespeare (author, Wikidata Q692), died 1616; François Guizot (translator, Wikidata Q157324), died 1874. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616; Guizot, François, 1787-1874 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Oeuvres completes de Shakspeare traduction de M. Guizot , Didier et c., 1861, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_YQ0bsatrlZwC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 80%, 81%, 79% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Shakespeare, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
